items.text: Extension of CBAM to Iceland and Norway

18Nov2026 | Extension of CBAM to Iceland and Norway | EEA Joint Committee Decision No 283/2026, which extends CBAM to Iceland and Norway, entered into force on 18 November 2026. From 1 January 2027, the same CBAM rules will apply to imports of covered goods into Iceland and Norway as to imports into the EU.
